name: Gloeophyllum trabeum

tip_speed.note: 7.1 to 9.1 mm daily radial increment on agar (the German summary says 7.4 to 9.1), midpoint 8.1 mm/day x 41.7. Read from a search snippet of the English summary of a 2002 paper on the Gloeophyllum species of buildings, Zeitschrift fuer Mykologie 68:141-152 (https://www.zobodat.at/pdf/Z-Mykologie_68_2002_0141-0152.pdf); the page refused to open, so authors, medium and temperature are unchecked

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

t_opt.source: Mizumoto 1954, Studies on Lenzites abietina Fr. and some of its allied species, Journal of the Japanese Forestry Society 36(2):48-52
t_opt.note: as Lenzites trabea, on agar; very vigorous from 32 to 36 C (abstract; reported together with L. subferruginea). The 2002 Zeitschrift fuer Mykologie paper (snippet only) gives 30 to 37.5 C

t_max.note: search snippet of Zeitschrift fuer Mykologie 68:141-152 (https://www.zobodat.at/pdf/Z-Mykologie_68_2002_0141-0152.pdf, not opened): the mycelium survived three weeks at 45 C. Survival is not growth, so the growth limit is probably a few degrees lower

size_cm.source: J.K. Lindsey, Ecology of Commanster, Gloeophyllum trabeum species page
size_cm.note: cap given as 10x30 to 30x80 mm; the longer dimension is used as the width. Naturalist web page, not a monograph

notes: Reported (unchecked) to be heat and drought tolerant, to have a sequenced genome and to be the third standard brown-rot test species.
